components.name: Entrar
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #c87431; color: #0d0908; font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b86a2c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c87431; outline-offset: 3px; }
